LanguageData.CC_After_Party_flashstorm: clearing the burnt ground after the flashstorm
LanguageData.CC_After_Chronicle_tornado: After the tornado, {PAWN_nameDef} and a few others cleared up the debris and mended the roofs and walls.
LanguageData.CC_After_Chronicle_flashstorm: Once the flashstorm's fires were out, {PAWN_nameDef} and a few others cleared the burnt ground and sowed again where the season allowed.
LanguageData.CC_After_Chronicle_hail: After the hail, {PAWN_nameDef} and a few others sowed the fields again where it had flattened the young crops.
LanguageData.CC_After_Chronicle_flood: When the flood went down, {PAWN_nameDef} and a few others carried what the water had left lying about back to the stores and cleaned up.
LanguageData.CC_Annals_After_hail: hail fell on the fields {0} times
LanguageData.CC_Annals_After_hail_Once: hail fell on the fields once
LanguageData.CC_Adv_LastWinter_Firewood: Last winter the cold here lasted {0} days, and the coldest night was {1}; at today's fires the wood in store lasts {2} such days.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_LastWinter_Stores: Last winter the cold here lasted {0} days, and only {1} of them stayed below freezing all day.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_LastWinter_Feed: Last winter the cold here lasted {0} days; the hay and kibble in store last {1} of them.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_LastWinter_FeedSnow: Last winter the cold here lasted {0} days, and the snow lay on the land for {1} of them; the hay and kibble in store last {2}.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_LastWinter_HerdCold: Last winter the coldest night here was {0}, and {1} days stayed below freezing all day.
LanguageData.CC_Play_Begin_RoundsHerd: {0}: {1} walks the pens and counts the herd ({2}).
LanguageData.CC_Play_End_RoundsHerd: {0} is over: {1} walked the pens and stopped by {2} of the herd.
LanguageData.CC_Play_Why_NoHerd: none of the herd could be reached
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_Done_Leader: {PAWN_nameDef} has counted the herd: {HEAD} head ({KINDS}), led by {LEADER}.
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_Against_more: That is more than last autumn's {HEAD}.
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_Against_fewer: That is fewer than last autumn's {HEAD}.
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_Against_same: That is the same as last autumn.
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_Chronicle: The autumn count: {PAWN_nameDef} counted {HEAD} head in the herd ({KINDS}).
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_Chronicle_Leader: The autumn count: {PAWN_nameDef} counted {HEAD} head in the herd ({KINDS}), led by {LEADER}.
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_SoldChronicle: {COUNT} of the herd's yearlings were sold to the traders, as the council chose at the autumn count.
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_SellLapsed: The {COUNT} yearlings kept for the traders since the autumn count weren't sold, so they stay with the herd and are no longer marked to sell.
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_TradersHere: The traders of {FACTION} have stopped at the colony. The yearlings the council chose to sell ({NAMES}) are marked to sell in the trade window.
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_PickOut: picking out the yearlings for the traders
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_TradeWhy: The council chose to sell this yearling to the next traders at the autumn count.
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_NoYearlings: There are no yearlings in the herd to sell.
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_SellMarked: {NAMES} are kept for the next traders and marked to sell in the trade window.
LanguageData.CC_HerdCount_OldestMarked: {NAMES} marked for slaughter, for the winter's meat.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_HerdSell: {NAMES} kept for the next traders who stop here: marked to sell in the trade window for {DAYS} days, and the one who counted the herd goes down to the pens for them when the traders come
LanguageData.CC_Impact_HerdOldest: {NAMES} marked for slaughter, the oldest first, never the herd's leader nor one of someone's own, bonded, named or carrying young, and a male and a female of each kind kept
LanguageData.CC_DefLine_AnimalNoted: brought down {COUNT} of the raiders at {LINE}
LanguageData.CC_DefLine_Raid_Animals: {COUNT} of the colony's animals fought there and brought down {BROUGHT}
LanguageData.CC_DefLine_Raid_AnimalsFell: {COUNT} of the colony's animals fought there and brought down {BROUGHT}, and {FELL} of the colony's animals were downed or killed there
LanguageData.CC_DefLine_Lesson_AnimalsBack: Keep {ANIMALS} back from the line: {COUNT} of the colony's animals were downed or killed there.
LanguageData.CC_DefLine_Lesson_AnimalsHeld: {ANIMALS} held their ground here: they brought down {COUNT} of the enemy, and none of them fell.
LanguageData.CC_DefLine_Lesson_Weather: The raid came in {WEATHER}: every shot where the shooter or the target was under the open sky had {AIM} of its usual aim, for both sides.
LanguageData.CC_DefLine_WeatherRaid: The raid comes in {WEATHER}. While it lasts, every shot where the shooter or the target is under the open sky has {AIM} of its usual aim, the raiders' and the colony's alike, turrets too. Under a roof at both ends, and in melee, nothing changes.
LanguageData.CC_DefLine_WeatherNow: Today's weather, {WEATHER}, leaves every shot where the shooter or the target is under the open sky at {AIM} of its usual aim, the raiders' and the colony's alike, turrets too. Under a roof at both ends, and in melee, nothing changes.
